title: Protect Elections from Deceptive AI Act
last_action: Referred to the House Committee on House Administration.
summary: Would prohibit knowing distribution of materially deceptive AI-generated audio or visual media involving federal candidates, or used in federal election activity, when intended to influence an election or solicit funds, subject to specified news, satire, and other exceptions.
committee_dynamics: The bipartisan House measure is related to S. 1213 and renews a proposal that advanced in the Senate during the 118th Congress as S. 2770, but the House bill itself had not advanced beyond referral.
advance_rationale: Bipartisan sponsorship and an earlier Senate committee precedent improve its prospects, although no House markup was recorded.
verification_level: Bill details and introduced text checked against official congressional sources.
